notes: Pose alignment uses orientation_pick (canonical up-axis) and yaw_pick_deg (in-plane Z rotation).
orientation_pick ∈ {posZ, negZ, posY, negY, posX, negX} — which native axis maps to world +Z.
yaw_pick_deg ∈ {0, 90, 180, 270} or null — additional rotation around world Z.
Some asset USDs (e.g. SM_Mug_*) carry source-side metersPerUnit metadata; spawning must use a parent-wrap pattern to preserve source xforms. See code/scene_per_category.py.
Rendering process for training data is NOT yet finalized — this file pins selection + canonical pose only.

conventions.shoe: toe-left flip-normalized; 'mirrored' entries need the (s,-s,s) pre-orientation scale at spawn
